description: Kurura model igirwa inama kugirango utangire kuganira, cyangwa shaka indi muri Hub.

welcomeTitle: Novera igomba kwishyirirwaho kuri sisitemu yawe
welcomeBody: Ibi bizafata iminota mike: Novera ikurura moteri yayo y’isesengura hamwe na modele ntoya yo gushakisha amadosiye. Ushobora gukomeza gukoresha mudasobwa yawe mu gihe iri gukora.
setupDoneBody: Novera izakoresha modeli z’aho iwuri hamwe na llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Irakurura DSpark Q8_0 yunganira ({{size}}) ku LFM2.5-2.6B. Bishobora kwihutisha ibisohoka, ariko bikoresha RAM cyangwa VRAM yinyongera, bigasiga ububiko buke ku buryo bw’ibitekerezo. Gerageza kuri mudasobwa yawe; hindura uburebure bw’ibitekerezo cyangwa ugahagarika kwisubiramo mu ishyirwaho ry’imodeli.
